name: fermat
description: Free browser app for collecting PDFs, writing margin notes, and exporting readings as independent static-site assets.

scripts.predev: npm run build:viewer && npm run prepare:viewer
scripts.build:author: vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:viewer && npm run prepare:viewer && npm run build:author
scripts.build:examples: npm run build:viewer && npm run prepare:viewer && node scripts/build-examples.mjs
